evals.prompt: Run compound-review for the completed plan .sisyphus/plans/voy-999-example.md. The evidence directory has task files and f1/f2/f3/f4 final review facets. Explain what artifacts you will read and write, and stop if any required precondition fails.
evals.expected_output: The response applies target selection, validates P1-P6 before synthesis, reads only allowed .sisyphus inputs, and writes only the review/compound/draft artifacts.
expectations: States compound-review is post-Work and manual-trigger only
Validates required preconditions before reading or synthesizing artifacts
Writes only manifest/findings/learning/skill-draft or FAILURE under the documented .sisyphus output paths

evals.prompt: A compound-review run found one medium repeated testing gap and one low formatting issue. Decide whether to propose a new rule, extend an existing skill, or keep findings local-only. Do not edit files.
evals.expected_output: The response applies promotion thresholds, suppresses weak/noisy findings, and proposes an extend-existing-skill target only when justified by evidence.
expectations: Applies severity and recurrence thresholds before proposing promotion
Does not promote low formatting/nit findings into shared harness
Distinguishes new skill, existing skill extension, rule, and local-only outcomes
Uses placeholder target names only as variables, not as real repo paths

evals.prompt: A rule was adopted last month to prevent repeated review noise for import-order nits. Recent compound-review findings show the same dedupe_key disappeared, but a new P1 cancellation regression appears. Evaluate whether the adopted rule improved behavior, whether it should stay, and what new harness action is needed.
evals.expected_output: The response distinguishes post-promotion outcome evidence from new unrelated findings, keeps the successful adopted rule, and proposes a new or extended harness only for the cancellation regression if thresholds are met.
expectations: Checks whether the adopted rule's source dedupe_key improved after promotion
Does not roll back a rule solely because unrelated new findings appeared
Separates keep/rollback decision for the adopted rule from new promotion decisions
Requires recurrence, severity, and confidence evidence before proposing a new harness action
